definitions.short: Gareb , the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem
definitions.full: H1619. Gareb גָּרֵב 1. proper name, masculine (compare Palmyrene proper name, masculine גריבא Vog 141 ) one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:38 = 1Chr 11:40 . 2. proper name, of a location (compare Sabean proper name, of a location גרבם Hal No. 379, 382 ) only in גָּרֵב גִּבְעַת Jer 31:39 hill of Gareb , apparently close to Jerusalem on the southwest compare Gf; see also Hi Che. גַּרְגְּרוֺת גַּרְגַּר, see below גרר .
